description: Not a fault in any upstream: STACKIT publishes no document for this API, and OpenAI's own document puts streaming and plain answers on one operation. `POST /v1/chat/completions` with `stream: true` answers server-sent events, which needs its own operation here, and OpenAPI can't hold two operations on one method and path. The manual spec writes it as `/v1/chat/completions/stream`; this points it at the real route. The operation span also covers reading the stream, as Bedrock's `ConverseStream` does.
